summary: Upexi, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an Advisory Services Agreement with Hivemind Capital Partners, LLC for consulting on business, operations, and capital markets strategies. The agreement has a three-year initial term, renewable annually. Compensation is a quarterly fee of 0.3125% of market cap (1.25% annually), payable in common stock, subject to a 9.99% beneficial ownership cap. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation is involved; this is a routine advisory engagement.
